en: Draupnir - Oh, Your Highness, you've returned. Well done, GS.
GS - A lot seems to have happened while we were away. The Empire attacked even here.

Draupnir - Not long after you left, Thunderdoom fell. As we feared, with no reserves we couldn't put up much resistance and were driven back. Pandragon and Cutis were retaken within days, and Astania has given up most of its land and is holding out under siege at Castle Astania. With the ports of both Cutis and Astania in enemy hands, Dagal is far from safe either. But tell me, is that huge fortress floating in the sky the Citadel of the Sky?
GS - Yes, it is. It's under our control now. I think we should move the equipment of Castle Dagal to the Citadel of the Sky. It's a mobile fortress that can never be taken.
Draupnir - Let's do that. They say the Empire has built new fortresses in Astania, Cutis and Pandragon. First we break those fortresses, then we march into the Empire to rescue Princess Iyolin!
